user_query: I'm planning a surprise party for my best friend and need to check the status of my Maytapi WhatsApp session. Can you also fetch the regional settings of my SMSAPI.com profile? Additionally, provide me with the user profile information for the LINE Messaging user with the ID '67890'.

Fetch the regional settings of the SMSAPI.com profile.
